column1: # DonorDesk Kestra plugin manifest — free (Apache-2.0) plugins only.
# `name` must be a valid shell-ish slug (no spaces) used for the JAR filename.
# The installer downloads each pinned artifact from Maven Central:
# IMPORTANT (gated): these plugin versions must be verified against the pinned
# Kestra core (1.3.30 on Contabo) before enabling flows that use them. Bump the
# version column to the LTS that matches your Kestra release; never `latest`.
# The four free plugins implemented for DonorDesk are:
#   1. Tika        — text/OCR extraction for evidence documents
#   2. Redis       — caching / TTL key-value store (Contabo host Redis)
#   3. JDBC-Postgres — read-only aggregation queries against the donordesk DB
#   4. GDrive + SFTP — inbound evidence ingestion connectors
